records.locator: Retained HTML extract lines69–82, Temperance Room/private dining
records.claim_text: Hawksmoor Manchester publishes a seated group range of 10–14 for the Temperance Room.
records.limitations: Room capacity is not an event-date reservation or suitability assessment. Additional distinct hosts and moderators consume seats.

records.locator: Retained HTML extract lines78–80, semi-private areas
records.claim_text: The same Hawksmoor page describes separate semi-private spaces for up to 30 or 50 guests.
records.limitations: Larger semi-private spaces are not equivalent to the 14-person private room; confidentiality, acoustics and actual layout remain unverified.

records.locator: PDF page3, Sharing Menus; live page group-sharing-menu link
records.claim_text: The live-linked Manchester sharing menu lists two/three-course per-person pairs: Moonlighter £65/£70, Silvertail £77/£82 and Hawkabelle £98/£103.
records.unit: GBP per person for specified course count
records.limitations: Published menu context only; minimum guest numbers may apply. No private-room total, future-date price, VAT/service basis or minimum-spend amount established by this page.

records.locator: PDF page9, Drinks Packages A; visual headings and price-per-person/whole-package wording
records.claim_text: Hawksmoor package A lists half a bottle of wine per person at £23, or a whole package including an arrival beer at £30, Prosecco at £35.50 or Champagne at £45.
records.unit: GBP per person for specified whole drinks package
records.limitations: The arrival-drink whole-package prices must not be added again to the base £23. Alcohol choice, non-alcohol alternatives, date, charge basis and employer acceptability remain open.

records.locator: PDF pages2,4 versus room page lines69–82
records.claim_text: Hawksmoor’s individual-menu service limit of up to 20 guests describes the menu format, while the Temperance Room page gives 14 seated places.
records.limitations: Do not substitute a generic menu-service limit for the capacity of the actual room. This does not establish availability of another fully private space.

records.claim_text: Benares publishes private-dining capacities of 11–16 for Berkeley and 17–36 for Dover; its smaller Chef’s and Sommelier’s tables have upper bounds of 8 and 10.
records.limitations: These are published room ranges, not a reservation, promised layout, minimum billable number or verified suitability. Exact booking configuration remains unconfirmed.

records.claim_text: Benares lists Bayleaf at £78, Fennel at £89 and Deluxe at £129 per person, or £147 with a glass of Champagne, for 1 September–15 November 2026.
records.unit: GBP per person, specified menu and period
records.limitations: Rates are within their printed period at capture. They do not establish a 2027 pilot price; all menus/prices are subject to change. Do not reuse the expired January menu as the current selection.

records.locator: PDF pages6,8, tasting menu heading and maximum
records.claim_text: Benares’s dated tasting menu is £139 per person, paired wines £129 per person, and is offered for the entire table up to 16 guests.
records.unit: GBP per person and distinct guests
records.limitations: Wine pairing is additional to food; neither is an all-in private-event price. The 16-person menu ceiling is separate from the Dover room’s published 17–36 range.

records.locator: PDF pages6–8, price footnotes and Additional Information
records.claim_text: Benares says the listed prices include VAT and adds a 2% cover charge and a discretionary 13% service charge.
records.unit: published percentage; calculation base not established
records.limitations: Retain the discretionary description. Do not add VAT again, infer tax recovery, assume charge compounding/base, or treat a future quotation as known.

records.locator: PDF page8, Additional Information, minimum-spend/hire sentence and starred note
records.claim_text: Benares’s guide states that minimum spend and hire charge apply for bookings described as over 9 and above, with further details referred to the Events Team.
records.limitations: The wording is awkward and does not supply Berkeley/Dover amounts or eligible-spend offset mechanics. Do not import the smaller-room published minima or assume hire is zero. No clarification was requested.

records.locator: PDF page8, Additional Information, timing and deposit
records.claim_text: Benares asks for final numbers 72 hours before booking and menu selection at least 14 days before the event; it says a deposit applies from 15 November to 30 December.
records.limitations: Deposit amount, refundability, cancellation exposure and balance date are not given. This seasonal statement does not prove that other dates have no deposit.

records.locator: Retained original HTML heading, parsed lines15–16
records.claim_text: Corrigan’s Lindsay Room retained HTML lists 24 boardroom and 40 reception capacity.
records.limitations: The web-reader text omits that heading; the original retained HTML and parsed extract support it. Reception capacity is not seated research-dinner capacity. Layout/privacy/date availability unverified.

records.locator: Retained HTML lines22–24, The Finer Details
records.claim_text: Corrigan’s says it charges no room hire fee for Lindsay Room and instead applies a minimum food-and-drink spend, with the amount obtainable from its team.
records.limitations: No-room-hire does not mean no minimum cost. The actual minimum, menu, charges, deposit and date-specific total remain unknown. No enquiry was made.

records.locator: Analytical application of room upper bound14 to agreed practitioner range12–15 plus distinct attendees
records.claim_text: The Temperance Room cannot seat the upper-end 15-practitioner concept even before any additional host; a smaller selected group fits only if every distinct seated person remains within 14.
records.limitations: An analyst capacity test, not a proposed reduction to the agreed target, staffing decision, room recommendation or actual attendance record.

records.claim_text: For a constructed total of 17 distinct attendees, Berkeley’s published 16-place limit and the 16-person tasting-menu limit both fail the screen; Dover’s 17–36 range passes only that numerical range check.
records.limitations: Seventeen is an illustrative total, not an agreed two-host requirement. Menu applicability, room terms, actual layout, employer acceptability and full total remain open.

records.claim_text: The selected public routes do not supply a complete date-specific private-event cost or the cancellation and cash schedule needed for an operating budget.
